definitions.full: H1131. Binnuwy בִּנּוּי proper name, masculine 1. head of a family that returned with Zerubbabel Neh 7:15 (= בָּנִי || Ezra 2:10 & perhaps 10:34 compare Sm Listen 14 ; but BeRy proposes here בִּגְוַי ). 2 a Levite of Ezra's time Ezra 8:33 ; Neh 10:10 (properly = בָּנִי 8:7 , בֻּנִּי 9:4 ) 12:8 ; compare 3:24 ( בַּוַי , textual error 3:18 ) see BeRy; also Ezra 2:40 = Neh 7:43 לִבְּנֵי read perhaps לְבִנֻּי compare Sm Listen 16 but BeRy otherwise; compare further Gr Geschichte.ii.2, 389. 3 Israelites of Ezra's time , a. Ezra 10:30 ; b. Ezra 10:38 .
